bwadmin: You already know how your office should run. Nobody has given you the tools.

Thirty six files. A hundred thousand lines. All of it built right here.
Google Apps Script. Salesforce. An AI agent on WhatsApp. Claude, with guardrails.
Half your day is the branch's administration. The other half is making that administration unnecessary.
You do not need to arrive knowing how. Nobody here was hired as a developer.
We are looking for one person who cannot leave a bad process alone.
Point your camera at the code. It takes fifteen minutes, and the Branch Manager reads every one himself.
bwagent: Most people start this career the same way. A list of your friends, and good luck.
That is not how it works here.
Your leads come from a board. People who asked to be called.
Your clients are matched to you, household by household, with the whole file already read.
The fact find does the arithmetic, and a manager signs it off before it reaches your client.
Your numbers are on the wall every day, in front of everybody. Mine are too.
If you are contracted somewhere today, nobody there will hear of this.
Point your camera at the code. See the whole thing before you apply.

The quote, the proposal form, the customer checks. All filled from the record, never typed twice.
The renewal desk reads every term since the policy began, before you open it.
A claim arrives already checked against the cover that was in force on the day of the loss.

If you are somewhere with no room to grow, this is a seat with the tools already built.
